scribe.transcript: This coral is about three hundred and eighty million years old. It grew a fine line every day and a thicker band every year. Count them, and a year had about four hundred days. So a day lasted about twenty-two hours, and Earth is still slowing down. The full film, What If Earth Stopped Spinning?

text: This coral is about three hundred and eighty million years old. It grew a fine line every day, and a thicker band every year. Count them, and a year had about four hundred days. So a day lasted about twenty-two hours. And Earth is still slowing down. The full film: What If Earth Stopped Spinning?
